# Synthetic application help fixture

## Upload documents
Open Legal → Documents → Upload. Choose a PDF, DOCX or TXT file. Files without a healthy malware scanner remain quarantined and cannot be parsed.

## Review a proposal
Open Legal → Reviews. An authorized reviewer may approve, reject, request changes or escalate. You cannot approve your own proposal.

## Delete conversation history
Open Ask my documents, select a conversation, and choose Delete history. Legal hold can block deletion.
